text.en:
Placing the FDCP under the Oversight of the DTI. Oversight of
the FDCP is hereby transferred from the DepEd to the DTI. The DTI shall exercise its
oversight over the FDCP under the terms governing the relationship of administrative
supervision.

Repeal. All orders, rules, regulations and issuances or parts thereof,
which are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 27th
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Two.
day of January
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
